Posting Instagram Pictures

How we post her pictures on Instagram: which picture, when, and exactly how. Watch first, then follow this step by step, every time.

Version v0.1Updated 10 Nov 2026Owner KTool Instagram app · Samsung
Download PDF

01Watch first

How we post on Instagram (Loom by K). Watch all of it before you start. Come back to it any time.

tutorial link

How to post photos on Instagram. Watch it once for the flow.

⚠ Read this before you watchA good video for the buttons. Watch the photo part only (stories and reels come later). Where it differs from the steps: the steps win. We never share to Facebook, never add a location.

Video not playing? Open it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mLacFydh9lM

02What this is

Her pictures are what make her feel real. Every post has to look like a girl posting her own life: the right picture, at the right time, with the right caption. Nothing that looks like a bot.

The posting rules Never before 8:00pm Bali. That's evening in Europe and morning in the US, when her fans are awake.
At least 1 hour between two pictures. Posting back to back looks like a bot.
K approves every picture before it goes up (while you're in training).
How many: your task says.
⚠ The rules that get accounts banned

NEVER CONNECT THE PHONE TO WI-FI. HOTSPOT ONLY.

NEVER DOWNLOAD A PICTURE FROM GOOGLE DRIVE ONTO THE PHONE. ALWAYS OPEN IT AND TAKE A SCREENSHOT.

The apps can see where a picture came from and how the phone connects. Break one of these and the account gets banned.

03Before you start

  • It's 8:00pm Bali or later.
  • The phone is on a hotspot.
  • You're in her Instagram on her phone (check the username top left).
  • Her pictures are in her Google Drive folder (SOPs: Creating Pictures, Google Drive).
  • The account has had 24 hours of warm up (new accounts only).

04Step by step

1

Pick a picture, ask K

Open her Drive folder and pick the picture you want to post. Send it to K and ask: "Can I post this one?"

K says no? Pick another one and ask again.

Why: one wrong picture (bad hands, a face that changes, something AI-looking) can make fans doubt her. Two eyes before it goes up.

Which pictures work: what is working now, from K’s Loom

2

Screenshot it from Drive

Open the picture in Google Drive, full screen. Take a screenshot. Crop the screenshot so only the picture is left.

NEVER download it from Google Drive. Always the screenshot.

Why: a downloaded file keeps where it came from. A screenshot is a fresh picture taken on this phone.

3

Open her profile → +

On her profile, press the + at the top right.

4

Post

In the Create menu, press Post.

5

Pick the screenshot → Next

Your screenshot is the first one in Recents. Tap it, check it fills the preview, press Next.

A carousel (more than one picture)? Press the two squares icon next to the camera first, then tap the pictures in the order you want them.

6

Leave it as it is → Next

No filter, no text, no stickers. Press Next.

Why: filters and text make it look edited and posted by a page. A real girl posts the picture as it is.

7

The caption

Tap Add a caption… and write the caption. Then Add music. the caption list and how to choose one

  • Add music: always. A song that fits her: from her niche (a soundtrack she’d love) or girly music that fits her vibe, like Clairo or Olivia Rodrigo.
  • Add location: never.
  • Tag people: never.
  • Also share on: Off. Never share to Facebook.

Why: sharing to Facebook links her Instagram to her Facebook. One ban, all banned.

8

Share

Press Share. Wait until it says the post is up. Open her profile and check it's there, looking right.

9

10 minutes of warm up

Straight after posting: 10 minutes on Instagram like a real person. SOP: Warming Up Instagram.

Why: an account that posts and leaves straight away looks like a bot. Being active after the post also helps it get seen.

10

Show it in your task

Take a screenshot of the post on her profile and put it in your task. Or tell Leon or K it's up, for sure.

11

The next picture: 1 hour later

If your task has more than one picture: at least 1 hour after this one. Start again from step 1.

05Done means

  • Every picture approved by K before it went up.
  • Posted from a screenshot, never a download.
  • Not before 8:00pm Bali, at least 1 hour apart.
  • Caption and music in. No location, no tags, not shared to Facebook.
  • 10 minutes of warm up after each post.
  • A screenshot of each post in your task.

06Common mistakes

  • Posting before 8:00pm Bali.
  • Two pictures less than an hour apart.
  • Leaving "Also share on Facebook" on.
  • Downloading the picture from Drive instead of a screenshot.
  • Posting from the wrong account. Check the username first.
  • Posting without K's yes.

Added after every review with K
